late_definition.note: Late = delivered after the time the platform promised the customer

slow_merchant_share.note: Account-management target: the 10% of merchants (50+ orders) with the largest pickup overrun

stack_cap.note: Like-for-like, a 3rd order in a run adds ~5 late points over a 2nd (sql Q6)

take_rate.note: Uber Q3 2026: Delivery revenue $5.5B / gross bookings $28.5B

merchant_fix_share.note: Share of the slowest merchants' pickup overrun removed by account management (prep-time fixes, earlier courier timing)

refusal_fix_share.note: Share of the delay from courier refusals removed by better matching / acceptance nudges

stack_reroute_share.note: Share of at-risk over-cap orders the dispatcher hands to another (idle) courier

stack_precision.note: Share of re-routed orders that would really have been late (the rest are re-routed unnecessarily)

reroute_cost_eur.note: Extra courier pay for a separate trip instead of a stacked drop

quest_share.note: Share of the courier gap that targeted quests bring online

quest_trigger_load.note: Quests fire only in district-half-hours whose load is above this

quest_leakage.note: Extra quest spend paid to couriers who would have worked anyway

blanket_bonus_eur.note: Blanket bonus per busy courier-hour at lunch (11-13) and dinner (17-20) peaks

blanket_show_share.note: Share of the courier gap that the blanket bonus brings online

basket_eur.note: Average basket (the Meituan data has no prices)

lost_orders_per_late.note: Future orders lost per late delivery (retention effect)
